definitions.explanation: Showing sadness in one's face, voice or manner, as seen from outside. Somewhat literary; used in narration and descriptions.

examples.japanese: {悲|かな}しげな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{去|さ}って→去る：02115_saru⟧いく⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悲|かな}しげ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見送|みおく}っていた→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧。
examples.english: On the station platform, she sadly watched the departing train go.

notes:
FORMS:
- {悲|かな}しげな + noun: sad-looking ~ ({悲|かな}しげな⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧, {悲|かな}しげな⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧)
- {悲|かな}しげ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: sadly, mournfully

USAGE:
The suffix げ added to an adjective stem means 'looking ~, with an air of ~'. It describes how someone appears to an observer, so it is not used of one's own feelings: say ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧, not {悲|かな}しげ, about yourself. Other common ones: {楽|たの}しげ, {寂|さび}しげ, ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧げ.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悲|かな}しそう: looks sad; the everyday conversational equivalent ({悲|かな}しそうな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧). {悲|かな}しげ is more literary
